newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends little changed at 1,086.55.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends little changed at 1,086.55.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended little changed against the dollar at 1,086.50 after a day of mostly sideways trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.
They said the effect of dollar sales by oil and coffee exporters was limited by demand for U.S. currency from the public sector and the peso ended up just 0.05 over Monday's close.
Dealers reported 357 trades for a total of $167 million and said the peso moved in a 1,085.05-to-1,088.75 range.
